import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# 1. Top selling products by total revenue
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
product_revenue = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', len(product_revenue))
product_revenue.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color=colors)
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Revenue ($)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Products by Revenue', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Sales distribution by customer age group
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales_ordered = age_sales.reindex([x for x in age_order if x in age_sales.index])
colors_age = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(age_sales_ordered))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax2.pie(age_sales_ordered, labels=age_sales_ordered.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors_age,
                                     textprops={'fontsize': 11, 'fontweight': 'bold'})
ax2.set_title('Revenue Distribution by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=10)

# 3. Payment method preferences by age group
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
payment_age = pd.crosstab(df['customer_age_group'], df['payment_method'], normalize='index') * 100
payment_age_ordered = payment_age.reindex([x for x in age_order if x in payment_age.index])
payment_age_ordered.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax3, stacked=False, 
                         color=sns.color_palette('Set2', len(payment_age.columns)))
ax3.set_xlabel('Customer Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Preferences by Age Group', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.legend(title='Payment Method', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=9, loc='upper right')
ax3.set_xticklabels(ax3.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Average transaction value by size and takeaway status
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
size_takeaway = df.groupby(['size', 'is_takeaway'])['total'].mean().unstack()
size_takeaway.columns = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_takeaway_ordered = size_takeaway.reindex([x for x in size_order if x in size_takeaway.index])
x = np.arange(len(size_takeaway_ordered))
width = 0.35
bars1 = ax4.bar(x - width/2, size_takeaway_ordered['Dine-in'], width, 
                label='Dine-in', color='#FF6B6B', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax4.bar(x + width/2, size_takeaway_ordered['Takeaway'], width, 
                label='Takeaway', color='#4ECDC4', alpha=0.8)
ax4.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Transaction Value ($)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Average Transaction Value by Size and Order Type', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.set_xticks(x)
ax4.set_xticklabels(size_takeaway_ordered.index)
ax4.legend(title='Order Type', title_fontsize=10, fontsize=10)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Add value labels on bars
for bars in [bars1, bars2]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax4.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                f'${height:.2f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
